messages:
laura_csm: Heads up — AstraWorks renewal is ~6 weeks out and their usage is down ~48% QoQ. Seats active: 120 -> 60; embeddings calls down ~70%. New procurement/tech lead joined from a competitor last month. Need quick triage and owner plan. @leo_sales @ian_se @maya_success
leo_sales: FYI I saw an email from their CTO asking for a side-by-side vs ForgeAI and on-prem options. They're specifically calling out latency at scale.
ian_se: I can pull the RFP and last demo notes. On the call with their ML lead they asked about quantized models + cost per token. Also flagged concerns about cold-start latency.
buildbot: runbook uploaded — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/astraworks-renewal (access: redwood/team-cs)
maya_success: Scheduling a health-check w/ customer for Tue 10am PT. We should also capture their top 5 production prompts and run a quality/regression check vs ForgeAI; will need samples. @ml_eval can you queue a light eval on those prompts?
ml_eval: Queued: light eval on top-5 prompts. ETA ~2h. Will return avg token latency, sample diffs, and a simple scorecard.
eng_guy: If they're considering Private/on-prem, ops/infra constraints matter. @ops can you confirm timeline for Private PoC vs full Private deployment? Also any blockers for quantized models on their infra?
ops: Typical Private deployment is 6-8 weeks (VPC + KMS/HSM + compliance). For a pilot we can do a 2-week cloud-hosted PoC if they sign the PoC SOW. Need legal + security signoff for data processing.
laura_csm: Proposed play: 1) Maya run health call and get top prompts; 2) Ian & Leo gather RFP + procurement notes; 3) ML eval to produce quick scorecard; 4) Ops to confirm PoC timeline and a 2-week pilot option; 5) I draft a 3-mo Dedicated pilot offer with SLA and migration credit to reduce friction. @legal please prioritize a PoC SOW template.
legal: Will draft PoC SOW template and share by EOD for review.
leo_sales: I'll probe whether the drop is due to seat reallocation (their Product team reorg) vs real dissatisfaction. If it's reassignments we can propose a short reactivation offer.
customer_adam: note from Adam (AstraWorks): "we're benchmarking. Quality when scaling matters most to us. Cost is second but still sensitive. Want to see A/B perf vs ForgeAI on our top workflows."
laura_csm: Thanks Adam — we'll follow up with a short one-pager comparing perf/cost tradeoffs and propose an A/B pilot against ForgeAI.
ian_se: Uploading the RFP snapshot and last demo notes to the thread after the call. Also adding the ask list: latency numbers, quantization support, rollout timeline, cost scenarios (pilot vs Dedicated).
maya_success: After health call I'll capture a concise action log and next steps and ping exec sponsor for a 2-week check-in if we do a PoC.
eng_guy: Quick FYI for sales: if they push for 99th%-ile latency guarantees we should be explicit about sequence lengths and batching impact. Suggest sharing a small table with SLOs per model/seq len.
laura_csm: Agreed. I'll assemble that SLO table + proposed pilot terms. We want to keep them from moving to a competitor PoC — propose a limited-time migration credit to lower immediate cost friction.
leo_sales: I'll prep a tailored commercial note to accompany the PoC SOW.
ops: If PoC approved, we can provision a small Dedicated pool for 2 weeks (est. 1-2 GPUs) to hit latency targets while we evaluate.
laura_csm: Great. Let's reconvene after ML eval completes and Maya's health call. Small, fast moves here — avoid letting procurement and the CTO chat with competitor too long. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
